name: Baby Bump
source:
You're hunting for your dream job when you get some unexpected news... you're pregnant! Chase your dreams, find love, and experience all the highs and lows of pregnancy in Baby Bump.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Baby_Bump]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当你正在寻找梦想的工作时，你收到了一些意想不到的消息……你怀孕了！在Baby Bump中追逐你的梦想，寻找爱情，体验怀孕期间的所有高潮和低谷。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Baby_Bump]Choices Wikia[/url]]
